log: Act V, G7: the central scene, from the frozen end of Act IV: out through the valley, along the road, up the pass, into the high valley; the letting go is set up, then up the ramp, along the ledge to the edge of the plateau, where she sits down beside the child
the end of Act IV: the house
the west path leads onto the road
the door at the north rim of the meadow: into the mountains
the scree is gone from the end of the path: a door into the high valley
the walk goes one step on
the keeper has written the letting go down (set up: the segment before it is another script)
the child sits on the flat stone at the edge of the plateau, looking down into the valley: she talks to it before she sits, and gets only narration (the child does not look up)
she sits down beside it: the child hums, six frames hang in the air, the answer, the child is gone
the walk goes one step on
in the valley a shoot grows in the bed
